cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's refundable only if we attend the first lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A small commitment can do the worrying for us.

mechanism: A coaches its former climbing pupil to pay a deposit whose refund condition makes attendance feel like protecting money rather than choosing a risky climb.
confusable: Not merely starting small practice: the first step creates an actual cost of refusing the larger activity.
comparison: Financial loss avoidance versus public reserved-date commitment.
